_doc: Hand-checked building facts that win over OSM tags. Only values with a public source. Match by OSM id ("osm": "w123"/"r123") or by name when no id is given. floors = storeys above ground; h = metres to roof. colour/material/roof/roofColour use OSM building:colour / building:material / roof:shape / roof:colour values. facade = window style in js/map.js (campus, glass, concrete, wash, arcade). feature = named extras drawn by js/map.js. move = [dx, dz] metres: shifts the whole footprint where OSM traced it off its place on the orthophoto. pts = [[x, z], ...] game metres: replaces the footprint where part of the OSM outline runs into a street on the orthophoto. split = cut the footprint into blocks: cuts[i] = [[x,z],[x,z]] (block 0 lies left of cut 0 seen from its first point), floors per block, optional h per block (metres; null = from floors), ac: true keeps the rooftop AC units the unsplit roof had (each one sits on the block under it, so js/map.js draws the same visual random stream as before the split). Colours and materials judged from the photos listed (viewed only; nothing from them is used as a texture, all textures are generated in js/map.js). Sources written as 'Google 街景目視判斷（影像 YYYY-MM，觀看點 lat,lon，朝向）' were looked at in Google Street View only: no image was saved or used, only medium/high-confidence sightings are applied (2026-11).

舊校門.note: Photo Cycu_gate.jpg (described 中原大學校門): three white concrete round arches side by side, with the characters 中原大學 on plaques. The current main gate (CYCU_Gate_New.jpg) is a twisted metal sculpture. Street view (high) at this POI's position confirms the structure: a free-standing frame of three equal semicircular white concrete arches (slightly weathered) on slim columns, no deck, no roof, the middle arch over the stone-paved driveway. Scaled from cars: columns ~4-5 m, ~7-8 m overall, so colH 4.5 m (was 5.2) and slimmer 0.55 m columns (was 0.7) give 4.5 + 2.8 + 0.6 = 7.9 m. The name 舊校門 comes from the OSM POI. Size re-measured (2026-11 survey and an independent re-check of the same panorama, scaled from a 1.65 m pedestrian under the arches): the whole frame is only ~8-10 m wide, not ~21 m: 4 slim square columns (~0.55 m, one shared column between neighbouring arches, not twin columns), clear span per arch ~2.3-2.7 m, springing ~4.5-5 m, arch crown ~6.5-7 m, arch ring ~0.4-0.5 m thick, no deck. So span 2.5, depth 0.45, ring 0.45 and colH 4.7 give 3 x 2.5 + 4 x 0.55 = 9.7 m wide and 4.7 + 1.25 + 0.45 = 6.4 m high. The middle arch (2.5 m clear) is narrower than the 4.2 m service road; js/map.js gives the two inner columns thin colliders so the player's car still drives through it, as it did through the old wide arch.

source: Google 衛星圖目視（比例尺 5 m 約 64 px，淺色圓盤直徑約 100 px）
中原噴水池.note: Street view (high): a low round raised basin of light grey stone, ~12-15 m across (d 13 m; the OSM water polygon is only ~8.7 m), rim ~0.4-0.5 m high, in a round grey stone-paved plaza with concentric curved stone benches / planters, palms beside it and the beige arcade building (懷恩樓) to the north. The basin was dry or low when photographed; the game keeps shallow water and the small spray. Re-measured (2026-11 survey + independent re-check, medium): the basin is ~8-9 m across (satellite ~8 m, the panorama 9-11 m with a larger error), so d 8.5 (was 13) and rim 0.4. The plaza is a disc of small dark-grey granite setts to r ~9.5 m (plaza) with a ~1 m light stone band round it (band); there is no full ring of benches (the four bench arcs were removed), only a white stone low wall ~0.4 m high on an arc ~11-13 m out on the west to north-west side (wall: r, from / to as fractions of pi with x = cos a, z = sin a, so 1 = due west and 1.25 = north-west; h, t in metres). The plaza radii no longer scale with the basin. The setts between the gutter stones at the rim and the band are the plaza's own paving (js/map.js draws no flat disc over it). Not modelled: the rounded bull-nose rim and the radial pattern on the basin floor (details, not size), and the ~10 m low curved stone planter / seat on the north-east side from the first survey (the re-check could not see the east half under the trees, so its radius and arc are unknown).

全人教育村柱廊.note: Street view (medium, independently re-checked): a row of very tall columns clad in silver-grey metal panels with rounded corners, ~0.8-1 m wide, 12 m+ (the tops leave the frame), ~4.5 m apart, joined by steel beams at the top into an open pergola, on the west edge of the 全人教育村 garden plaza, running north-east to south-west parallel to the campus grid; ground level the same inside and out. Measured run (game x/z): from (-82.5,-76.7) to (-74.7,-87.2), 4 columns at ~4.4 m; the OSM footway from 全人大道 ends beside the first column, so the run is moved 2 m along itself to the south-east (within the measuring error) to keep that column 1.9 m off the footway's centre line instead of standing on the paving. h 13 m (12 m+ seen), w 0.9 m, beam = length of the short beams reaching into the plaza (estimate). js/map.js draws it; the column colliders are added after the trees are planted, so tree placement does not change.

levels_doc: Outdoor level changes the 10 m terrain grid cannot show (js/terrain.js 'height levels'). Each site has a local frame: o = origin [x, z] in game metres, u = direction [dx, dz]; a local point [s, t] is o + s*u' + t*v' with u' = u normalised and v' = u' turned 90 degrees ((ux, uz) -> (-uz, ux)). Heights y are absolute game metres (data/terrain.json, ref 135 m) or 'ground' (terrain under that end). sink = rectangle [s0, s1, t0, t1] whose terrain posts tools/build_terrain.py pins to y (below-ground plazas). pads = raised flat areas (pts in [s, t], top y; edge: what sits on top of a wall: hedge / railing / none). stairs = from a (bottom) to b (top) [s, t], width w, heights y0 -> y1, steps (0 = ramp), rail: center / sides / none; a ramp with top (paving colour) is drawn as a sloping paved terrace and may take edge: hedge. floors = paving drawn on the terrain. js/map.js draws walls wherever an edge drops more than 0.3 m and seals them for collision; stairs and ramps are the openings.

levels.name: 泉源之谷（泉源之台）下沉廣場
source: Google 街景目視判斷（影像 2017-09，全景 3bA-kBr12kmj0mIVPop5dA 觀看點 24.9579467,121.2412731，朝 15、130、250 度）
Google 地圖使用者 360 照片 Geoforce GBV Nina（2019-06/07，24.9577169,121.2413179）
Google 衛星圖目視（標示「中原大學泉源之谷廣場」）
levels.note: Two surveys name the same plaza 泉源之谷 / 泉源之台 (probably the library's 'sunken garden'). Frame: o = the OSM plaza polygon's SW corner, u along its south edge, so the plaza is s 0..43.4, t -23..0 (t < 0 = north). Placement follows OSM (the footway area polygon and the steps way at its SE corner); the two surveys put the east stairs about 15 m further north (stairs-west: x -127..-121, z 4..20; central-axis: stairs (-120, 11), ramp (-118, 3), south wall z 17), but both are bearings and distances read off panoramas (medium / low confidence) and were not cross-checked on satellite imagery, so OSM wins until someone checks. Sunk to -0.8 (level with the lawn to the north, which both surveys say is open). South: dark brick retaining wall with a hedge on top. The terrace behind it runs to 懷恩樓 and stops 0.3 m short of its north face; it is a paved ramp following the ground along the arcade (terrain 0.1-0.2 at the west end, 0.5-0.7 at the east end), from 0.25 at the west stairs to 1.05 at the east end (road level), so the arcade is not buried. The wall is therefore 1.05 m high at the west end and 1.85 m at the east end (surveys: 1.5-2.5 m; central-axis: the east part about 1 m lower). West: two-run stairs with a centre rail up to the terrace's west landing (0.25; wall 1.05 m, 7 steps). The surveys say 2.4-2.8 m (low confidence); the terrace cannot be higher there without burying the arcade, as 懷恩樓 is drawn on the terrain. The landing's north and west sides face the lawn towards the library (-0.4..-0.55), so they get a 0.6-0.8 m wall with the hedge (not surveyed). East: wide stairs to the road level (6 steps / 1.0 m and 11 steps / 1.8 m in the two surveys; OSM step_count 6) taken as 8 x 0.156 m, 15 m wide, with the brick wall on their right; the accessible ramp north of them is a switchback in reality, drawn as one straight 1.8 m ramp (1:9), and the raised planter between ramp and stairs is a pad. The east landing (0.45) is the road level; its north end has a stone wall and railing. The terrace's west end slopes down to the footway along 懷恩樓 (assumed: not surveyed).

levels.name: 良善小門（A2 門）台階
source: Google 街景目視判斷（影像 2017-09，觀看點 24.955648,121.2419948，朝 215 度；舊版窄樓梯）
levels.note: Frame: o = the OSM steps' top end (where the campus paths meet), u down the steps towards 大仁街. Rebuilt in 2024 as the A2 gate: wide open stairs (about 7 m, 6-7 steps, 1.0-1.2 m) with a black centre rail rising north-east from a small street plaza to the campus ground. The terrain here (10 m grid, smoothed) only falls 0.36 m from the campus paths (2.06) to the street (1.72), so the full height cannot be shown without lowering the street: the stairs (4 x 0.11 m over 3 m, from 1.76) rise to a landing at 2.2, level with the campus ground to the east (良善樓 side, 2.1-2.3) and a kerb under 0.3 m from the path junction, so the way down is monotonic. The landing's north-west side runs parallel to the path west along the campus edge (1 m off it) so that path stays open, and its other low sides are sealed only where they drop more than 0.3 m. The stairs' foot stops 4.5 m short of the OSM end, behind the footway along 大仁街 (the street wall is opened in front of it), so that strip is left as terrain for the 'street plaza' (low confidence); its 2-3 steps and the A2 sign wall are not modelled.

levels.name: 維澈樓西側抬高平台
source: Google 街景目視判斷（影像 2017-09，全景 nDeuCW6RAPYJknjU3a1b1w 觀看點 24.9572155,121.2406134，朝 110、165 度）
levels.note: Frame: o = 維澈樓's west corner (OSM w392023424), u along its west face to the north, t < 0 = the paved plaza in front. A platform about 0.6 m above the plaza in front of the ground-floor colonnade: fair-faced concrete parapet with green double railings, 4 steps (0.15 m) up to it and an accessible ramp alongside, a two-run switchback (2017 photo from the plaza, 2022 photo from 大仁街): the first run starts on the plaza behind the directory board and climbs south along the back of the grey name wall and the board (js/gate_extras.js, which stand against its outer concrete wall), 8 m to a 1.5 m landing at 1.55 near the car park portal; the second run, higher and on the building side, climbs back north 10 m and comes out on a small top landing beside the 4 steps (open to the terrace west of the first colonnade column), about 1:26 and 1:25 (the photos show long runs reaching from the steps towards 大仁街; the exact lengths are estimates). The terrace south of the steps is set back to t -3.4 to leave room for the second run (planting there in reality, not modelled). Extent along the face is an estimate (2017 imagery). Kept clear of the main gate (guardhouse, barriers, roads), which another change rebuilds.

grade_doc: Off-campus grade separations the OSM ways and the 10 m terrain grid cannot show (tools/build_map.py build_grade, js/map.js and js/terrain.js 'grade separations', tools/build_terrain.py cut fill). Coordinates are game metres [x, z]. path = centreline of the item (the matched OSM ways: same road name, or type for a footway, every point within 1.5 m of it). kind: viaduct = elevated deck over streets that stay at grade; footbridge = pedestrian bridge between two buildings (deck at a constant height, truss drawn by js/map.js); cut = road below the ground (open cut between retaining walls, roofed where the OSM way is a tunnel). prof = [x, z, value] anchors projected onto the path and joined linearly (value = deck height above the ground there for decks, depth below the ground for cuts; ends hold their value). w = deck / cut width (also the matched roads' width). move = OSM node id -> new [x, z] (hand corrections, see note). clear = {d, margin, below, narrow}: nodes of other roads that lie closer than d to the path, where prof is above 0 (and below 'below', i.e. where the deck is too low to pass under) within margin metres (or [before, after]) of their projection, are pushed out to d on their own side; narrow = {road type: width} for the roads that had a node pushed. Heights are estimates from street view unless a sign was read.

grade.name: 普忠路地下道
grade.confidence: high（南側引道與箱涵）；北側引道 medium（沒有街景，照南側對稱推估）
grade.note: 路塹加箱涵穿過縱貫線。南側引道從 (250,-435) 開始往下，(230,-460) 低約 2 m、(207,-492) 低約 3.5–4 m，箱涵從 (176,-522) 起最深約 6 m（淨高約 4.6 m 加頂板）；北側引道沒有確認，取 (95,-603) 回到地面。雙向 4 車道，中央雙黃線；米白色混凝土擋土牆，牆頂金屬欄杆，箱涵有照明、洞口有限高牌。寬度用 13 m（4 車道 x 3.25 m；OSM 推算的 14.6 m 會和兩側地面車道重疊）。兩側 unclassified 單行道是牆頂外的地面機車道，OSM 畫得離主線太近（中心線距離 4–8.5 m），所以推到 8.9 m 外、寬度改成 3.5 m。OSM 的人行地下道 (139,-559)→(166,-527) 沒有確認，不另外做，也不畫它自己的洞口（build_map.py 標成 beside）。

grade.name: 中山東路一段高架（跨縱貫線）
source: Google 街景目視判斷（影像 2026-05，中山東路一段 261 號側車道 (-765,191) 往西看）
OSM 中山東路一段 bridge=yes layer=1 (-848.9,106.9)→(-716.0,254.7)；OSM 新中北路在 (-755.2,211.6) 從橋下穿過
台灣道路一般限高 4.6 m
grade.note: 高架跨過縱貫線（約 (-828,126)，在可玩範圍外 8 m），推估橋面 7–8 m，取 7.5；(-765,191) 側車道上看橋底約 5–6 m，橋面取 6.5（橋底約 5.8 m 加梁）；新中北路在 (-755.2,211.6) 從橋下穿過，橋面取 5.4（淨高 4.7 m 加 0.7 m 梁，不低於 4.6 m 限高）；往東北在中北路口 (-716,254.7) 落地，最後約 58 m 的坡度約 9%。OSM 的橋端點可能比實際偏西，坡道起點和新中北路下方的淨高都是推估，需要再實地確認。西段 (-1025,152) 和普義路高架都在地圖外，只為了從地圖邊看過去連得起來，落地點是假設。寬度 10 m：OSM 沒有 width / lanes，13 m 是遊戲對 secondary 的預設值，會蓋到兩側的側車道。兩個中間節點往鐵路側（西北）移 1.5 m，橋面低於 3.2 m 的引道段（落地前約 35 m），側車道推到中心線 7.6 m 外（會碰到建物的地方少推一些，寬度改成 3.6 m），讓側車道維持在地面、不會開上橋；更高的地方側車道照 OSM 從橋面邊緣底下通過。

grade.note: 橘紅色 Warren 鋼桁架，白色頂棚，掛紅色布條。桁架下緣 4.7 m（限高牌），橋面約 5.1 m（以新中北路中心的地面為準），桁架高約 2.6 m，淨寬約 2.8 m。兩端直接接進力行舍和學生活動中心約 2F，沒有獨立樓梯，所以玩家上不去；路上的人和車從橋下過。
